long_biography.plain_text:
Australian equestrian supporter Valerie Oatley co-owned the dressage mare Sommernacht with Rosalind Oatley. Ridden by her great-granddaughter Rose, the horse won team and individual gold at the 2023 European Junior Championships in Kronberg. Rose had been riding Sommernacht since the mare was six, developing the partnership over two years before those victories.

Sailing also featured in Valerie's life with her husband Bob. They spent Australian winters in Porto Cervo, Sardinia, where they owned a home and made friends in the sailing community. She also joined him aboard during the 2007 Geelong Week Passage Race.
